parameters.query: UPDATE automacao_miller.email_deliveries SET status = 'solicitado', error_message = 'Entrega recuperada após timeout.', execution_id = NULL WHERE status = 'enviando' AND requested_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'; WITH stale AS (SELECT submission_id FROM automacao_miller.documents WHERE status = 'em_processamento' AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'), closed_attempts AS (UPDATE automacao_miller.processing_attempts pa SET status = 'erro', current_stage = 'reconciliacao', error_category = 'infraestrutura', error_message = 'Tentativa recuperada após timeout.', finished_at = NOW() FROM stale WHERE pa.submission_id = stale.submission_id AND pa.status = 'em_processamento'), reset AS (UPDATE automacao_miller.documents d SET status = 'recebido', current_stage = 'reconciliacao', updated_at = NOW(), message = 'Retomada automática após timeout.' FROM stale WHERE d.submission_id = stale.submission_id RETURNING d.submission_id) SELECT submission_id FROM reset UNION SELECT submission_id FROM automacao_miller.documents WHERE status = 'recebido' ORDER BY submission_id LIMIT 20;
